format: Apertura: a round robin, then the top 8 in two-legged quarter-finals, semi-finals and a final.
Finalización: a round robin, then the top 8 in two groups of four (1st and 2nd head them) played home and away, and the group winners in a two-legged final.
Each stage crowns its own champion.
The Reclasificación adds up every match, the playoffs included; it decides the continental places after the champions.
The bottom 2 of the promedio go down: points per match over 3 seasons, a club promoted since averaging over its own seasons.

Sudamericana Colombia 1 is the Copa BetPlay champion (Art. 31); the simulation draws it from the Copa Colombia's own simulation when there is one, and passes it down the reclasificación when the winner already holds a place (press reports; the article does not say).
